def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a and b else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    sep_col = next(c for c in range(w) if len({row[c] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0)
    n = min(sep_col, w - sep_col - 1)
    return [[2 if row[c] and row[sep_col + 1 + c] else 0 for c in range(n)] for row in grid]
